text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp is finally starting. As I was getting fired up for our training—
"Watch out! It's heavy, so be careful not to hurt yourself!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Much appreciated!
Now then, I'd like you to carry it into that building over there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking toward the voice, I saw people carrying large packages under Chairwoman Akikawa's direction.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer <username>!
I bring great tidings for all Trainers preparing for the summer training camp!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: To ensure an even more fulfilling summer training camp, we've set up a VR Umalator at the camp lodgings too!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
By all means! Just like when you're at the academy,
make full use of training with the Three Goddesses!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Chairwoman Akikawa's unexpected gift,
we were able to train alongside the Three Goddesses
even during the training camp!
